card: aifoundry2 card 0, under its own governor (65 W static TDP, 65 C threshold: read, never set), BL2 0.22.0
_note: frozen before any claim and any launch; nothing fitted or refitted: every prediction is Q140(x)'s, copied by key after its sha256 check, or the frozen predictor's own output

primary.model: M9's aifoundry2 part (Q140(l)): predict_m9_a2.burst(D, t, anchors, die_starts, D_band_hw), recomputed per tile
primary.D: tiles.<name>.models.M9.D600_a3_footing_w (M9's frozen D at 600 MHz on aifoundry3's footing)
primary.D_band_hw: tiles.<name>.models.M9.D_band_hw (half the width of M9.D600_a3_95; it enters only the peak)
primary.anchors: the session's zeros-anchor reads: per format, every counted burst of its anchor7_zeros tile ({burst_w, burst_mhz, die_start}, as the registered reduction reads them); burst() keeps those at 795 MHz or more, fills a format with none from the others, and takes the frozen fallback if none at all
primary.die_starts: the tile's own counted bursts' die starts (one per counted pass)
primary.quantities: burst_mhz, burst_board_w, burst_die_rise_c and their 95% bands, as burst() returns them (rounded by the frozen code)
primary.groups: fixed by the frozen file: tiles.<name>.group = M9.a2_q140l.group (governed below 795 MHz at the fallback and T_ref)
primary.beside: the frozen file's M9.a2_q140l block as frozen (fallback offset, T_ref 54.38 C); M8, M7 and M6 as frozen

resolved.form: e165_common.paired_rms_diff: the 95% interval of rms(M9 primary) - rms(M7 as frozen) over the set's tiles; resolved better if its upper end is below 0

rules.c_check: a burst counts only if every launch of it (the calibration launch included) has a C record that reads PASS in ccheck.py check (bit-exact against Q139(k)'s reference); ROUNDING, UNMODELLED, FAIL and a missing record are not checked

dma.rule: E160's: the smoke's median launch gap less E143's smoke median is the C log's extra time per launch (delta); the session runs only if E143's longest device-held time (s1, 6.57 s) + 17 x delta <= 7.2 s, else QUEUE-HALT
